title: [main] Bug 647991 Assembly-to-Order Item Incorrectly Blocks Shipment of Unrelated Sales Order Line
summary: A fix prevents Assemble-to-Order sales lines from incorrectly blocking the shipment of unrelated non-ATO lines on the same order when warehouse activities are pending.
key_points: Posting inventory picks for non-ATO lines no longer fails due to pending warehouse activities on separate ATO lines
The assembly order's Quantity to Assemble is not updated when component warehouse activities remain outstanding
A new event subscriber on 'OnBeforeModifySalesLine' handles the skip logic
Allows independent posting of non-ATO lines without interference from unrelated ATO line workflows
Test coverage added for Assembly-to-Order warehouse scenarios
quote: Assembly-to-Order Item Incorrectly Blocks Shipment of Unrelated Sales Order Line
